252+ this.sql.exec(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${column} ${definition}`)

256+ provision(input: ProvisionChannelBindingInput): ChannelBinding {
257+ const now = Date.now()
258+ const row = this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO boring_channel_bindings
259+ (channel, conversation_key, agent_type_id, workspace_id, auth_subject_id, binding_version, status, session_key, outbound_cursor)
260+ VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?)
261+ ON CONFLICT(channel, conversation_key, agent_type_id) DO UPDATE SET
262+ workspace_id=excluded.workspace_id,
263+ auth_subject_id=excluded.auth_subject_id,
264+ binding_version=boring_channel_bindings.binding_version + 1,
265+ status=excluded.status,
266+ session_key=excluded.session_key,
267+ create_state=NULL,
268+ create_owner=NULL,
269+ create_expires_at=NULL,
270+ create_session_key=NULL,
271+ outbound_cursor=CASE
272+ WHEN boring_channel_bindings.session_key IS excluded.session_key
273+ AND boring_channel_bindings.workspace_id=excluded.workspace_id
274+ AND boring_channel_bindings.auth_subject_id=excluded.auth_subject_id
275+ THEN boring_channel_bindings.outbound_cursor
276+ ELSE excluded.outbound_cursor
277+ END,
278+ outbound_status='active',
279+ session_reset_pending=0,
280+ template_sent_for_inbound_at=NULL
281+ WHERE (boring_channel_bindings.outbound_claim_owner IS NULL
282+ OR boring_channel_bindings.outbound_claim_expires_at<=?)
283+ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_intentions i
284+ WHERE i.channel=boring_channel_bindings.channel
285+ AND i.conversation_key=boring_channel_bindings.conversation_key
286+ AND i.agent_type_id=boring_channel_bindings.agent_type_id
287+ AND i.binding_version=boring_channel_bindings.binding_version
288+ AND ((i.status='projecting' AND i.claim_expires_at>?) OR i.status='answering'))
289+ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe d
290+ JOIN boring_channel_intentions i ON i.question_id=d.question_id
291+ AND i.binding_version=d.binding_version
292+ WHERE i.channel=boring_channel_bindings.channel
293+ AND i.conversation_key=boring_channel_bindings.conversation_key
294+ AND i.agent_type_id=boring_channel_bindings.agent_type_id
295+ AND i.binding_version=boring_channel_bindings.binding_version
296+ AND d.status='sending' AND d.claim_expires_at>?)
297+ RETURNING channel, conversation_key, agent_type_id, workspace_id, auth_subject_id,
298+ binding_version, status, session_key, last_inbound_at, outbound_cursor, outbound_status,
299+ session_reset_pending, template_sent_for_inbound_at`,
300+ input.channel, input.conversationKey, input.agentTypeId, input.workspaceId,
301+ input.authSubjectId, input.status ?? 'active', input.sessionKey ?? null,
302+ input.outboundCursor ?? '-1', now, now, now).toArray()[0]
303+ if (!row) {
304+ throw Object.assign(new Error('Channel binding has active outbound delivery.'), {
305+ code: ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_BINDING_BUSY,
306+ })
307+ }
308+ return bindingFromRow(row)
309+ }

311+ getBinding(channel: string, conversationKey: string, agentTypeId: string): ChannelBinding | undefined {
312+ const row = this.sql.exec(`SELECT channel, conversation_key, agent_type_id, workspace_id,
313+ auth_subject_id, binding_version, status, session_key, last_inbound_at, outbound_cursor,
314+ outbound_status, session_reset_pending, template_sent_for_inbound_at FROM boring_channel_bindings
315+ WHERE channel=? AND conversation_key=? AND agent_type_id=?`, channel, conversationKey, agentTypeId).toArray()[0]
316+ return row ? bindingFromRow(row) : undefined
317+ }
318+
319+ enqueueInbound(message: InboundChannelMessage, agentTypeId: string): EnqueueInboundResult {
320+ return this.runTransaction(() => {
321+ const existing = this.sql.exec(`SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_inbound_dedupe
322+ WHERE channel=? AND provider_message_id=?`, message.channel, message.providerMessageId).toArray()[0]
323+ if (existing) {
324+ const binding = this.getBinding(message.channel, message.conversationKey, agentTypeId)
325+ return {
326+ disposition: 'duplicate',
327+ ...(binding?.status === 'active' ? { binding } : {}),
328+ } as const
329+ }
330+
331+ const binding = this.getBinding(message.channel, message.conversationKey, agentTypeId)
332+ if (!binding || binding.status !== 'active') return { disposition: 'unknown_binding' } as const
333+ // Unknown identities are not consumed: every retry remains fail-closed,
334+ // and a later explicit provision can safely admit the same provider id.
335+ this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO boring_channel_inbound_dedupe(channel, provider_message_id, seen_at)
336+ VALUES (?, ?, ?)`, message.channel, message.providerMessageId, message.receivedAt)
337+
338+ const inserted = this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO boring_channel_inbound_queue
339+ (channel, conversation_key, agent_type_id, workspace_id, auth_subject_id, binding_version,
340+ provider_message_id, text, received_at)
341+ VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id`, message.channel, message.conversationKey,
342+ agentTypeId, binding.workspaceId, binding.authSubjectId, binding.bindingVersion,
343+ message.providerMessageId, message.text, message.receivedAt).toArray()[0]
344+ this.sql.exec(`UPDATE boring_channel_bindings SET
345+ template_sent_for_inbound_at=CASE
346+ WHEN last_inbound_at IS NULL OR ? > last_inbound_at THEN NULL
347+ ELSE template_sent_for_inbound_at
348+ END,
349+ last_inbound_at=CASE WHEN last_inbound_at IS NULL OR ? > last_inbound_at THEN ? ELSE last_inbound_at END
350+ WHERE channel=? AND conversation_key=? AND agent_type_id=?`, message.receivedAt,
351+ message.receivedAt, message.receivedAt, message.channel, message.conversationKey, agentTypeId)
352+ const updatedBinding = this.getBinding(message.channel, message.conversationKey, agentTypeId) ?? binding
353+ return { disposition: 'enqueued', binding: updatedBinding, queueId: Number(inserted!.id) } as const
354+ }, 'immediate')
355+ }

401+ conversation_key=excluded.conversation_key,
402+ agent_type_id=excluded.agent_type_id,
403+ binding_version=excluded.binding_version,
404+ field_name=excluded.field_name,
405+ options_json=excluded.options_json,

408+ status='pending',
409+ claim_owner=NULL,
410+ claim_expires_at=NULL,
411+ answer_values_json=NULL,
412+ answer_provider_message_id=NULL,
413+ updated_at=excluded.updated_at
414+ WHERE boring_channel_intentions.session_id=excluded.session_id
415+ AND boring_channel_intentions.status IN ('pending', 'projecting', 'window-held', 'projected')
416+ AND (boring_channel_intentions.channel<>excluded.channel
417+ OR boring_channel_intentions.conversation_key<>excluded.conversation_key
418+ OR boring_channel_intentions.agent_type_id<>excluded.agent_type_id
419+ OR boring_channel_intentions.binding_version<>excluded.binding_version)
420+ RETURNING question_id`,
421+ input.questionId, input.sessionId, input.channel, input.conversationKey, input.agentTypeId,

507+ claimIntentionReply(
508+ intention: ChannelIntentionRecord,
509+ providerMessageId: string,
510+ values: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
511+ owner: string,
512+ ttlMs = INTENTION_CLAIM_TTL_MS,
513+ ): ClaimIntentionReplyResult {
514+ return this.runTransaction(() => {
515+ const duplicate = this.sql.exec(`SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe
516+ WHERE channel=? AND provider_message_id=?`, intention.channel, providerMessageId).toArray()[0]
517+ if (duplicate) return { disposition: 'duplicate' } as const
518+ const now = Date.now()
519+ const claimed = this.sql.exec(`UPDATE boring_channel_intentions SET status='answering',
520+ claim_owner=?, claim_expires_at=?, answer_values_json=?, answer_provider_message_id=?, updated_at=?
521+ WHERE question_id=? AND binding_version=? AND status='projected'
522+ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_bindings b
523+ WHERE b.channel=boring_channel_intentions.channel
524+ AND b.conversation_key=boring_channel_intentions.conversation_key
525+ AND b.agent_type_id=boring_channel_intentions.agent_type_id
526+ AND b.binding_version=boring_channel_intentions.binding_version
527+ AND b.session_key=boring_channel_intentions.session_id AND b.status='active')
528+ RETURNING *`, owner, now + ttlMs, JSON.stringify(values), providerMessageId, now,
529+ intention.questionId, intention.bindingVersion).toArray()[0]
530+ if (!claimed) return { disposition: 'no_intention' } as const
531+ this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe
532+ (channel, provider_message_id, seen_at, question_id, binding_version, status)
533+ VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'sent')`, intention.channel, providerMessageId, now,
534+ intention.questionId, intention.bindingVersion)
535+ return { disposition: 'claimed', intention: intentionFromRow(claimed) } as const
536+ }, 'immediate')
537+ }

544+ AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_bindings b

573+ claimInvalidIntentionReply(
574+ intention: ChannelIntentionRecord,
575+ providerMessageId: string,
576+ owner: string,
577+ ttlMs = INTENTION_CLAIM_TTL_MS,
578+ ): ClaimInvalidIntentionReplyResult {
579+ return this.runTransaction(() => {
580+ const now = Date.now()
581+ const authoritative = this.sql.exec(`SELECT 1 FROM boring_channel_intentions i
582+ JOIN boring_channel_bindings b ON b.channel=i.channel AND b.conversation_key=i.conversation_key
583+ AND b.agent_type_id=i.agent_type_id AND b.binding_version=i.binding_version
584+ AND b.session_key=i.session_id AND b.status='active'
585+ WHERE i.question_id=? AND i.binding_version=? AND i.status='projected'`,
586+ intention.questionId, intention.bindingVersion).toArray()[0]
587+ if (!authoritative) return { disposition: 'no_intention' } as const
588+ const existing = this.sql.exec(`SELECT status, claim_expires_at
589+ FROM boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe WHERE channel=? AND provider_message_id=?`,
590+ intention.channel, providerMessageId).toArray()[0]
591+ if (existing && (existing.status === 'sent' || Number(existing.claim_expires_at) > now)) {
592+ return { disposition: 'duplicate' } as const
593+ }
594+ const row = existing
595+ ? this.sql.exec(`UPDATE boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe
596+ SET question_id=?, binding_version=?, status='sending', claim_owner=?, claim_expires_at=?
597+ WHERE channel=? AND provider_message_id=? AND status='sending' AND claim_expires_at<=?
598+ RETURNING provider_message_id`, intention.questionId, intention.bindingVersion,
599+ owner, now + ttlMs, intention.channel, providerMessageId, now).toArray()[0]
600+ : this.sql.exec(`INSERT INTO boring_channel_intention_reply_dedupe
601+ (channel, provider_message_id, seen_at, question_id, binding_version, status, claim_owner, claim_expires_at)
602+ VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'sending', ?, ?) RETURNING provider_message_id`, intention.channel,
603+ providerMessageId, now, intention.questionId, intention.bindingVersion, owner, now + ttlMs).toArray()[0]
604+ return row ? { disposition: 'claimed' } as const : { disposition: 'duplicate' } as const
605+ }, 'immediate')
606+ }

758+ pendingBindings(): ChannelBinding[] {
759+ return this.sql.exec(`SELECT DISTINCT b.channel, b.conversation_key, b.agent_type_id,
760+ b.workspace_id, b.auth_subject_id, b.binding_version, b.status, b.session_key, b.last_inbound_at,
761+ b.outbound_cursor, b.outbound_status, b.session_reset_pending, b.template_sent_for_inbound_at
762+ FROM boring_channel_bindings b JOIN boring_channel_inbound_queue q
763+ ON q.channel=b.channel AND q.conversation_key=b.conversation_key AND q.agent_type_id=b.agent_type_id
764+ WHERE q.status IN ('pending', 'processing')`).toArray().map(bindingFromRow)

766+
767+ nextPending(
768+ channel: string,
769+ conversationKey: string,
770+ agentTypeId: string,
771+ claimOwner: string,
772+ claimTtlMs = INBOUND_CLAIM_TTL_MS,
773+ ): NextInboundResult {
774+ return this.runTransaction(() => {
775+ const now = Date.now()
776+ this.sql.exec(`UPDATE boring_channel_inbound_queue
777+ SET status='pending', claim_owner=NULL, claim_expires_at=NULL
778+ WHERE channel=? AND conversation_key=? AND agent_type_id=? AND status='processing'
779+ AND claim_expires_at<=?`, channel, conversationKey, agentTypeId, now)
780+ // The oldest unfinished row is a binding-wide database lock. A second
781+ // process cannot claim a later row while the first owns a live lease.
782+ const candidate = this.sql.exec(`SELECT * FROM boring_channel_inbound_queue
783+ WHERE channel=? AND conversation_key=? AND agent_type_id=? AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
784+ ORDER BY id LIMIT 1`, channel, conversationKey, agentTypeId).toArray()[0]
785+ if (!candidate) return { disposition: 'empty' } as const
786+ if (candidate.status === 'processing') {
787+ return { disposition: 'blocked', retryAt: Number(candidate.claim_expires_at) } as const
788+ }
789+ const claimed = this.sql.exec(`UPDATE boring_channel_inbound_queue
790+ SET status='processing', attempts=attempts+1, claim_owner=?, claim_expires_at=?
791+ WHERE id=? AND status='pending' RETURNING *`, claimOwner, now + claimTtlMs, candidate.id).toArray()[0]
792+ return claimed
793+ ? { disposition: 'claimed', inbound: inboundFromRow(claimed) } as const
794+ : { disposition: 'blocked', retryAt: now + claimTtlMs } as const
795+ }, 'immediate')
796+ }

827+
828+ async ensureSession(binding: ChannelBinding, options: EnsureSessionOptions): Promise<{ sessionKey: string; created: boolean }> {
829+ if (binding.sessionKey) return { sessionKey: binding.sessionKey, created: false }
830+ const ttl = options.reservationTtlMs ?? RESERVATION_TTL_MS
831+ const maxCycles = options.maxReservationCycles ?? 2
832+ let backoff = options.initialBackoffMs ?? 50
833+ const owner = randomUUID()
834+ let cycles = 0
835+
836+ while (cycles < maxCycles) {
837+ const currentBinding = this.getBinding(binding.channel, binding.conversationKey, binding.agentTypeId)
838+ if (!currentBinding || currentBinding.status !== 'active' || currentBinding.bindingVersion !== binding.bindingVersion
839+ || currentBinding.workspaceId !== binding.workspaceId || currentBinding.authSubjectId !== binding.authSubjectId) {
840+ throw Object.assign(new Error('Channel binding is revoked.'), { code: ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_BINDING_REVOKED })
841+ }
842+ if (currentBinding.sessionKey) return { sessionKey: currentBinding.sessionKey, created: false }
843+ const creation = this.readCreation(binding)
844+ const now = Date.now()
845+
846+ if (creation && creation.expiresAt > now) {
847+ await delay(backoff)

231+ private async readUnreadEvents(streamPath: string, durableCursor: string): Promise<{
232+ entries: Array<{ data: unknown; offset: string }>
233+ assembled?: AssembledTurn
234+ }> {
235+ const entries: Array<{ data: unknown; offset: string }> = []
236+ let readCursor = durableCursor

238+ for (;;) {
239+ const page = await this.events.readEvents(streamPath, { offset: readCursor, limit: 1_000 })
240+ for (const entry of page.events) {
241+ lastOffset = entry.offset
242+ if (isAssemblyEvent(entry.data)) entries.push(entry)

244+ const assembled = assembleNextTurn(entries, this.now(), this.stallTimeoutMs())
245+ if (assembled) {
246+ return {
247+ entries,
248+ assembled: assembled.turn.status === 'stalled'
249+ && entries.filter((entry) => isAgentEvent(entry.data) && entry.data.chunk.type === 'agent-start').length === 1
250+ ? { ...assembled, terminalOffset: lastOffset }
251+ : assembled,
252+ }
253+ }
254+ if (page.upToDate || page.nextOffset === readCursor) return { entries }
255+ readCursor = page.nextOffset
256+ }
257+ }

407+ },

418+ text: 'I could not complete that request. Please try again.',
419+ },
420+ }

422+ if (!active) continue
423+ if (chunk.type === 'error' && (!chunk.turnId || chunk.turnId === active.turnId)) {
424+ return {
425+ terminalOffset: entry.offset,
426+ turn: {
427+ turnId: active.turnId,
428+ status: 'error',
429+ text: 'I could not complete that request. Please try again.',
430+ },
431+ }

467+export function shapeChannelText(text: string, dialect: string, maxLength = 4_096): string[] {
468+ const rendered = dialect === 'whatsapp/markdown' ? renderWhatsAppMarkdown(text) : text
469+ if (rendered.length <= maxLength) return [rendered]
470+ const chunks: string[] = []
471+ let remaining = rendered
472+ while (remaining.length > maxLength) {
473+ let split = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n\n', maxLength)
474+ if (split < Math.floor(maxLength / 2)) split = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n', maxLength)
475+ if (split < Math.floor(maxLength / 2)) split = maxLength
476+ let chunk = remaining.slice(0, split)
477+ remaining = remaining.slice(split).replace(/^\n+/, '')
478+ if ((chunk.match(/```/g) ?? []).length % 2 === 1) {
479+ const closeFence = '\n```'
480+ if (chunk.length + closeFence.length > maxLength) {
481+ const keep = maxLength - closeFence.length
482+ remaining = chunk.slice(keep) + remaining
483+ chunk = chunk.slice(0, keep)
484+ }
485+ chunk += closeFence
486+ remaining = `\`\`\`\n${remaining}`
487+ }
488+ chunks.push(chunk)
489+ }
490+ if (remaining.length > 0) chunks.push(remaining)
491+ return chunks
492+}

494+function renderWhatsAppMarkdown(text: string): string {
495+ let inFence = false
496+ return text.split(/(```)/g).map((section) => {
497+ if (section === '```') {
498+ inFence = !inFence
499+ return section
500+ }
501+ if (inFence) return section
502+ return section
503+ .replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/gm, '')
504+ .split('\n')
505+ .filter((line) => !/^\s*\|?(?:\s*:?-{3,}:?\s*\|)+\s*$/.test(line))
506+ .map((line) => {
507+ if (!line.includes('|')) return line
508+ const cells = line.replace(/^\s*\|/, '').replace(/\|\s*$/, '').split('|').map((cell) => cell.trim())
509+ return cells.join(' — ')
510+ })
511+ .join('\n')
512+ .replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*\n]+)\*(?!\*)/g, '$1_$2_')
513+ .replace(/\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g, '*$1*')
514+ }).join('')

517+function displayText(message: { parts: readonly { type: string; text?: string }[] }): string {

520+ (part.type === 'text' || part.type === 'notice') && typeof part.text === 'string')

529+ || value.chunk.type === 'agent-end'

536+ return candidate.v === 1 && typeof candidate.timestamp === 'number'
537+ && !!candidate.chunk && typeof candidate.chunk === 'object'

406+export class ChannelMessageRouter {
407+ constructor(
408+ private readonly intentions: ChannelIntentionService,
409+ private readonly inbound: ChannelInboundService,
410+ ) {}

412+ async accept(message: InboundChannelMessage, agentTypeId: string): Promise<ChannelMessageAck> {

418+
419+function answerableField(question: ChannelIntentionQuestion): ChannelIntentionField | undefined {
420+ if (question.status !== 'ready' || question.schema?.wireVersion !== 1 || question.schema.fields.length !== 1) return undefined
421+ const field = question.schema.fields[0]
422+ return field && (field.type === 'radio' || field.type === 'select') && field.options && field.options.length >= 2
423+ ? field
424+ : undefined
425+}
426+
427+function parseChoice(text: string, options: readonly ChannelIntentionOption[]): ChannelIntentionOption | undefined {
428+ const normalized = text.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()
429+ const ordinal = /^([1-9][0-9]*)[.)]?$/.exec(normalized)
430+ if (ordinal) return options[Number(ordinal[1]) - 1]
431+ return options.find((option) => option.value.toLocaleLowerCase() === normalized
432+ || option.label.toLocaleLowerCase() === normalized)
433+}
434+
435+function projectionText(intention: ChannelIntentionRecord): string {
436+ return [
437+ intention.title ?? 'Your approval is needed',
438+ ...(intention.context ? [intention.context] : []),
439+ ...intention.options.map((option, index) => `${index + 1}. ${option.label}${option.description ? ` — ${option.description}` : ''}`),
440+ 'Reply with the option number or label.',
441+ ].join('\n')
442+}
443+
444+function invalidChoiceText(intention: ChannelIntentionRecord): string {
445+ return `That is not a valid choice. Reply with ${intention.options.map((_, index) => index + 1).join(' or ')}.`
446+}

99+export class WhatsAppCloudAdapter implements ChannelOutboundAdapter<WhatsAppCloudMessage> {
100+ readonly serviceWindowMs = WHATSAPP_SERVICE_WINDOW_MS
101+ private readonly request: typeof fetch
102+ private readonly origin: string
103+
104+ constructor(private readonly options: WhatsAppCloudAdapterOptions) {
105+ this.request = options.fetch ?? fetch
106+ this.origin = (options.graphApiOrigin ?? WHATSAPP_GRAPH_API_ORIGIN).replace(/\/$/, '')
107+ }
108+
109+ renderOutbound(turn: ChannelOutboundTurn): readonly WhatsAppCloudMessage[] {
110+ return shapeWhatsAppText(turn.text, 4_096).map((body) => ({
111+ messaging_product: 'whatsapp' as const,
112+ recipient_type: 'individual' as const,
113+ type: 'text' as const,
114+ text: { body, preview_url: false as const },
115+ }))
116+ }
117+
118+ async send(input: { readonly conversationKey: string; readonly message: WhatsAppCloudMessage }): Promise<void> {
119+ await this.options.withCredentials((credentials) =>
120+ this.sendPayload({ ...input.message, to: input.conversationKey }, credentials))
121+ }
122+
123+ async sendWindowTemplate(input: { readonly conversationKey: string }): Promise<void> {
124+ await this.options.withCredentials((credentials) => this.sendPayload({
125+ messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
126+ recipient_type: 'individual',
127+ to: input.conversationKey,
128+ type: 'template',
129+ template: {
130+ name: credentials.fallbackTemplateName,
131+ language: { code: credentials.fallbackTemplateLanguage ?? 'en' },
132+ },
133+ }, credentials))
134+ }
135+
136+ private async sendPayload(message: WhatsAppCloudMessage, credentials: WhatsAppCloudCredentials): Promise<void> {
137+ const apiVersion = credentials.apiVersion ?? 'v25.0'
138+ if (!/^v\d+\.\d+$/.test(apiVersion) || !/^\d+$/.test(credentials.phoneNumberId)) {
139+ throw new WhatsAppCloudApiError(0, false)
140+ }
141+ const response = await this.request(
142+ `${this.origin}/${apiVersion}/${credentials.phoneNumberId}/messages`,
143+ {
144+ method: 'POST',
145+ headers: {
146+ authorization: `Bearer ${credentials.accessToken}`,
147+ 'content-type': 'application/json',
148+ },
149+ body: JSON.stringify(message),
150+ },
151+ )
152+ if (!response.ok) {
153+ let providerTransient = false
154+ let providerCode: number | undefined
155+ try {
156+ const payload: unknown = await response.json()
157+ if (isRecord(payload) && isRecord(payload.error)) {
158+ providerTransient = payload.error.is_transient === true
159+ providerCode = typeof payload.error.code === 'number' ? payload.error.code : undefined
160+ }
161+ } catch {
162+ // A non-JSON failure still has reliable HTTP retry semantics.
163+ }
164+ const transientCodes = new Set([1, 2, 4, 17, 32, 613, 80007])
165+ const retryable = providerTransient || (providerCode !== undefined && transientCodes.has(providerCode))
166+ || response.status === 408 || response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500
167+ throw new WhatsAppCloudApiError(response.status, retryable)
168+ }
169+ }
170+}

172+export function createWhatsAppFetchHandler(options: WhatsAppWebhookHandlerOptions) {
173+ const handle = createWhatsAppWebhookHandler(options)
174+ return async (request: Request): Promise<Response> => {
175+ const method = request.method.toUpperCase()
176+ if (method !== 'GET' && method !== 'POST') return new Response('method not allowed', { status: 405 })
177+ const announcedLength = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0)
178+ const limit = options.bodyLimit ?? WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BODY_LIMIT
179+ if (Number.isFinite(announcedLength) && announcedLength > limit) return new Response('payload too large', { status: 413 })
180+ const body = method === 'POST' ? await readRequestBody(request, limit) : undefined
181+ if (body === undefined && method === 'POST') return new Response('payload too large', { status: 413 })
182+ const handled = await handle({
183+ method,
184+ url: request.url,
185+ headers: Object.fromEntries(request.headers.entries()),
186+ ...(body ? { body } : {}),
187+ })
188+ return new Response(handled.body, { status: handled.status, headers: { 'content-type': handled.contentType } })
189+ }
190+}

192+export function createWhatsAppWebhookHandler(options: WhatsAppWebhookHandlerOptions) {
193+ return async (input: WhatsAppWebhookInput): Promise<WhatsAppWebhookResult> => options.withCredentials(async (credentials) => {
194+ if (input.method === 'GET') return verifyChallenge(input.url, credentials.verifyToken)
195+
196+ const body = input.body ?? new Uint8Array()
197+ if (body.byteLength > (options.bodyLimit ?? WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BODY_LIMIT)) {
198+ return result(413, 'payload too large')
199+ }
200+ const signature = header(input.headers, 'x-hub-signature-256')
201+ if (!signature || !await verifySignature(body, signature, credentials.appSecret)) {
202+ return result(401, 'invalid signature')
203+ }
204+
205+ let payload: unknown
206+ try {
207+ payload = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(body))
208+ } catch {
209+ return result(400, 'invalid json')
210+ }
211+ let messages: InboundChannelMessage[]
212+ try {
213+ messages = parseWhatsAppInbound(payload, options.now?.() ?? Date.now())
214+ } catch {
215+ return result(400, 'invalid envelope')
216+ }
217+ for (const message of messages) await options.acceptInbound(message)
218+ return result(200, JSON.stringify({ accepted: messages.length }), 'application/json')
219+ })
220+}
221+
222+export function parseWhatsAppInbound(payload: unknown, receivedAt = Date.now()): InboundChannelMessage[] {
223+ if (!isRecord(payload) || payload.object !== 'whatsapp_business_account' || !Array.isArray(payload.entry)) {
224+ throw new Error('Invalid WhatsApp webhook envelope')
225+ }
226+ const output: InboundChannelMessage[] = []
227+ for (const entry of payload.entry) {
228+ if (!isRecord(entry) || !Array.isArray(entry.changes)) throw new Error('Invalid WhatsApp webhook entry')
229+ for (const change of entry.changes) {
230+ if (!isRecord(change) || typeof change.field !== 'string' || !isRecord(change.value)) {
231+ throw new Error('Invalid WhatsApp webhook change')
232+ }
233+ if (change.field !== 'messages') continue
234+ if (!Array.isArray(change.value.messages)) {
235+ if (Array.isArray(change.value.statuses)) continue
236+ throw new Error('Invalid WhatsApp messages change')
237+ }
238+ for (const message of change.value.messages) {
239+ if (!isRecord(message) || typeof message.id !== 'string' || typeof message.from !== 'string'
240+ || typeof message.type !== 'string') throw new Error('Invalid WhatsApp message')
241+ const text = inboundText(message)
242+ if (text === undefined) {
243+ if (message.type === 'text' || message.type === 'interactive') throw new Error('Invalid supported WhatsApp message')
244+ continue
245+ }
246+ const timestamp = typeof message.timestamp === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(message.timestamp)
247+ ? Number(message.timestamp) * 1_000
248+ : receivedAt
249+ output.push({
250+ channel: WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_ID,
251+ conversationKey: message.from,
252+ providerMessageId: message.id,
253+ text,
254+ receivedAt: Number.isSafeInteger(timestamp) ? timestamp : receivedAt,
255+ })
256+ }
257+ }
258+ }
259+ return output
260+}

262+export async function verifySignature(body: Uint8Array, signature: string, appSecret: string): Promise<boolean> {
263+ if (!/^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(signature)) return false
264+ const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
265+ 'raw', new TextEncoder().encode(appSecret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign'],
266+ )
267+ const rawBody = Uint8Array.from(body).buffer
268+ const digest = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, rawBody))
269+ return constantTimeEqual(digest, decodeHex(signature.slice(7)))
270+}
271+
272+function verifyChallenge(url: string, verifyToken: string): WhatsAppWebhookResult {
273+ const query = new URL(url, 'https://webhook.invalid').searchParams
274+ const challenge = query.get('hub.challenge')
275+ const supplied = query.get('hub.verify_token')
276+ if (query.get('hub.mode') !== 'subscribe' || challenge === null || supplied === null
277+ || !constantTimeEqual(new TextEncoder().encode(supplied), new TextEncoder().encode(verifyToken))) {
278+ return result(403, 'verification failed')
279+ }
280+ return result(200, challenge)
281+}
282+
283+function inboundText(message: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
284+ if (message.type === 'text' && isRecord(message.text) && typeof message.text.body === 'string') return message.text.body
285+ if (message.type === 'interactive' && isRecord(message.interactive)) {
286+ const choice = message.interactive.type === 'button_reply' ? message.interactive.button_reply : message.interactive.list_reply
287+ if (isRecord(choice)) {
288+ if (typeof choice.id === 'string') return choice.id
289+ if (typeof choice.title === 'string') return choice.title
290+ }
291+ }
292+ return undefined
293+}

295+async function readRequestBody(request: Request, limit: number): Promise<Uint8Array | undefined> {
296+ if (!request.body) return new Uint8Array()
297+ const reader = request.body.getReader()
298+ const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
299+ let size = 0
300+ try {
301+ for (;;) {
302+ const next = await reader.read()
303+ if (next.done) break
304+ size += next.value.byteLength
305+ if (size > limit) {
306+ await reader.cancel()
307+ return undefined
308+ }
309+ chunks.push(next.value)
310+ }
311+ } finally {
312+ reader.releaseLock()
313+ }
314+ const body = new Uint8Array(size)
315+ let offset = 0
316+ for (const chunk of chunks) {
317+ body.set(chunk, offset)
318+ offset += chunk.byteLength
319+ }
320+ return body
321+}
322+
323+function shapeWhatsAppText(text: string, maxLength: number): string[] {
324+ const rendered = renderWhatsAppMarkdown(text)
325+ const chunks: string[] = []
326+ let remaining = rendered
327+ while (remaining.length > maxLength) {
328+ let split = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n\n', maxLength)
329+ if (split < Math.floor(maxLength / 2)) split = remaining.lastIndexOf('\n', maxLength)
330+ if (split < Math.floor(maxLength / 2)) split = maxLength
331+ if (split > 0 && isHighSurrogate(remaining.charCodeAt(split - 1))) split -= 1
332+ let chunk = remaining.slice(0, split)
333+ remaining = remaining.slice(split).replace(/^\n+/, '')
334+ if ((chunk.match(/```/g) ?? []).length % 2 === 1) {
335+ const closeFence = '\n```'
336+ if (chunk.length + closeFence.length > maxLength) {
337+ let keep = maxLength - closeFence.length
338+ if (keep > 0 && isHighSurrogate(chunk.charCodeAt(keep - 1))) keep -= 1
339+ remaining = chunk.slice(keep) + remaining
340+ chunk = chunk.slice(0, keep)
341+ }
342+ chunk += closeFence
343+ remaining = `\`\`\`\n${remaining}`
344+ }
345+ chunks.push(chunk)
346+ }
347+ if (remaining.length > 0 || chunks.length === 0) chunks.push(remaining)
348+ return chunks
349+}
350+
351+function renderWhatsAppMarkdown(text: string): string {
352+ let inFence = false
353+ return text.split(/(```)/g).map((section) => {
354+ if (section === '```') {
355+ inFence = !inFence
356+ return section
357+ }
358+ if (inFence) return section
359+ return section
360+ .replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/gm, '')
361+ .replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*\n]+)\*(?!\*)/g, '$1_$2_')
362+ .replace(/\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g, '*$1*')
363+ }).join('')
364+}
365+
366+function isHighSurrogate(value: number): boolean {
367+ return value >= 0xd800 && value <= 0xdbff
368+}
369+
370+function constantTimeEqual(left: Uint8Array, right: Uint8Array): boolean {
371+ let difference = left.byteLength ^ right.byteLength
372+ const length = Math.max(left.byteLength, right.byteLength)
373+ for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) difference |= (left[index] ?? 0) ^ (right[index] ?? 0)
374+ return difference === 0
375+}
376+
377+function decodeHex(value: string): Uint8Array {
378+ const output = new Uint8Array(value.length / 2)
379+ for (let index = 0; index < output.length; index += 1) output[index] = Number.parseInt(value.slice(index * 2, index * 2 + 2), 16)
380+ return output
381+}
382+
383+function header(headers: WhatsAppWebhookInput['headers'], name: string): string | undefined {
384+ if (!headers) return undefined
385+ const target = name.toLowerCase()
386+ for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(headers)) if (key.toLowerCase() === target) return value
387+ return undefined
388+}
389+
390+function result(status: number, body: string, contentType: WhatsAppWebhookResult['contentType'] = 'text/plain'): WhatsAppWebhookResult {
391+ return { status, body, contentType }
392+}
393+
394+function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
395+ return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)

7+export const CHANNEL_INBOUND_PARKED = ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_INBOUND_PARKED

16+/**

19+ */
20+export interface ChannelAgentInvoker {

23+ readonly authSubjectId: string
24+ readonly agentTypeId: string

38+ * fence that makes an expired queue lease safe to replay.
39+ */
40+ prompt(input: ChannelAgentInvocation): Promise<void>
41+ /** Same durable idempotency and sequence contract as prompt. */

48+ readonly agentTypeId: string
49+ readonly sessionKey: string

51+ /** Monotonic durable queue id; stale/lower deliveries must be a no-op. */
52+ readonly deliverySequence: number

54+}

56+export type ChannelInboundAck =
57+ | { readonly accepted: true; readonly duplicate: boolean; readonly code: typeof ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_INBOUND_ACCEPTED }
58+ | { readonly accepted: false; readonly duplicate: boolean; readonly code: typeof CHANNEL_UNKNOWN_BINDING }

60+export class ChannelInboundService {
61+ private readonly drains = new Map<string, Promise<void>>()
62+ private readonly retryTimers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()
63+ private readonly claimOwner = randomUUID()
64+ private disposed = false
65+
66+ constructor(
67+ private readonly store: ChannelBindingStore,
68+ private readonly invoker: ChannelAgentInvoker,
69+ private readonly options: {
70+ readonly maxAttempts?: number
71+ readonly inboundClaimTtlMs?: number
72+ readonly drainRetryMs?: number
73+ /** Called after durable completion, including work resumed at startup. */
74+ readonly onInboundDelivered?: (binding: ChannelBinding) => void
75+ } = {},
76+ ) {
77+ // Durable acknowledgement must not depend on a provider replay. The store
78+ // recovers interrupted claims during migration; every new service resumes
79+ // all active bindings with unfinished work.
80+ for (const binding of this.store.pendingBindings()) this.scheduleDrain(binding)
81+ }
82+
83+ /** Durable enqueue is the acknowledgement boundary; agent work stays async. */
84+ accept(message: InboundChannelMessage, agentTypeId: string): ChannelInboundAck {
85+ const result = this.store.enqueueInbound(message, agentTypeId)
86+ if (result.disposition === 'duplicate') {

88+ // after commit but before the background drain started.
89+ if (result.binding) this.scheduleDrain(result.binding)
90+ return { accepted: true, duplicate: true, code: ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_INBOUND_ACCEPTED }
91+ }
92+ if (result.disposition === 'unknown_binding') {
93+ return { accepted: false, duplicate: false, code: CHANNEL_UNKNOWN_BINDING }
94+ }
95+ this.scheduleDrain(result.binding)
96+ return { accepted: true, duplicate: false, code: ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_INBOUND_ACCEPTED }
97+ }

101+ }

104+ this.disposed = true
105+ for (const timer of this.retryTimers) clearTimeout(timer)
106+ this.retryTimers.clear()

108+ }
109+
110+ resume(binding: ChannelBinding): void {
111+ if (binding.status === 'active') this.scheduleDrain(binding)
112+ }
113+
114+ private scheduleDrain(binding: ChannelBinding): void {
115+ if (this.disposed) return
116+ const key = bindingKey(binding)
117+ if (this.drains.has(key)) return
118+ let failed = false
119+ const drain = Promise.resolve().then(() => this.drain(binding)).catch(() => {

122+ if (this.drains.get(key) === drain) this.drains.delete(key)

125+ this.retryTimers.delete(timer)
126+ this.scheduleDrain(binding)
127+ }, this.options.drainRetryMs ?? 50)
128+ this.retryTimers.add(timer)
129+ }
130+ })
131+ this.drains.set(key, drain)
132+ }
133+
134+ private async drain(initialBinding: ChannelBinding): Promise<void> {
135+ let binding = initialBinding
136+ for (;;) {
137+ const claimTtlMs = this.options.inboundClaimTtlMs ?? INBOUND_CLAIM_TTL_MS
138+ let claimed
139+ try {
140+ claimed = this.store.nextPending(
141+ binding.channel,
142+ binding.conversationKey,
143+ binding.agentTypeId,
144+ this.claimOwner,
145+ claimTtlMs,
146+ )
147+ } catch {
148+ await delay(this.options.drainRetryMs ?? 50)

150+ }

152+ if (claimed.disposition === 'blocked') {
153+ await delay(Math.max(1, claimed.retryAt - Date.now()))

155+ }
156+ const queued = claimed.inbound

161+ // generation and can never redirect already accepted content.
162+ this.store.parkInbound(queued.id, ErrorCode.enum.CHANNEL_BINDING_REVOKED, queued.claimOwner)
163+ continue
164+ }
165+ let claimLost = false
166+ const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
167+ try {
168+ if (!this.store.renewInbound(queued.id, queued.claimOwner, claimTtlMs)) claimLost = true
169+ } catch {
170+ // The downstream sequence fence makes a replay safe, but this owner
171+ // must stop advancing the binding after it loses renewal.
172+ claimLost = true
173+ }
174+ }, Math.max(1, Math.floor(claimTtlMs / 3)))
175+ try {
176+ const ensured = await this.store.ensureSession(binding, {
177+ allocate: () => this.invoker.createSession({
178+ workspaceId: binding.workspaceId,
179+ authSubjectId: binding.authSubjectId,
180+ agentTypeId: binding.agentTypeId,
181+ originChannel: binding.channel,
182+ requestId: sessionCreationRequestId(binding),
183+ }),
184+ admit: async (sessionKey) => this.invoker.prompt(invocation(binding, sessionKey, queued)),
185+ })
186+ if (!ensured.created) {
187+ const call = invocation(binding, ensured.sessionKey, queued)
188+ const busy = await this.invoker.isSessionBusy({
189+ workspaceId: binding.workspaceId,
190+ authSubjectId: binding.authSubjectId,
191+ agentTypeId: binding.agentTypeId,
192+ sessionKey: ensured.sessionKey,
193+ })
194+ await (busy ? this.invoker.followUp(call) : this.invoker.prompt(call))
195+ }
196+ if (claimLost || !this.store.completeInbound(queued.id, queued.claimOwner)) {
197+ // The row remains durably processing until its last possible lease
198+ // expires. Stay alive and reclaim it without requiring new inbound.
199+ await delay(claimTtlMs)
200+ continue
201+ }
202+ binding = this.store.getBinding(binding.channel, binding.conversationKey, binding.agentTypeId) ?? binding

204+ } catch (error) {
205+ const code = stableErrorCode(error)
206+ if (queued.attempts < (this.options.maxAttempts ?? 3)) {
207+ this.store.retryInbound(queued.id, queued.claimOwner, code)
208+ } else {
209+ this.store.parkInbound(queued.id, code || CHANNEL_INBOUND_PARKED, queued.claimOwner)
210+ }
211+ } finally {

213+ }

215+ }
216+}
217+
218+function invocation(
219+ binding: ChannelBinding,
220+ sessionKey: string,
221+ queued: { id: number; providerMessageId: string; text: string },
222+): ChannelAgentInvocation {

224+ workspaceId: binding.workspaceId,
225+ authSubjectId: binding.authSubjectId,
226+ agentTypeId: binding.agentTypeId,
227+ sessionKey,
228+ requestId: `channel:${binding.channel}:${queued.providerMessageId}`,
229+ deliverySequence: queued.id,
230+ text: queued.text,
231+ }
232+}
233+
234+function bindingKey(binding: ChannelBinding): string {

247+
248+function delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
249+ return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
250+}
251+
252+function stableErrorCode(error: unknown): string {
253+ const code = (error as { code?: unknown })?.code
254+ return typeof code === 'string' && code.length > 0 ? code : CHANNEL_INBOUND_PARKED

11+ createWhatsAppCloudEdge,

14+ type WhatsAppCloudCredentials,
15+ type WhatsAppCloudMessage,
16+ type WithWhatsAppCloudCredentials,
17+} from '@hachej/channel-whatsapp'
18+
19+export const CORE_WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_PATH = '/api/channels/whatsapp/webhook'

21+export interface CoreWhatsAppChannelOptions {
22+ readonly withCredentials: WithWhatsAppCloudCredentials
23+ readonly agentTypeId: string
24+ /** Pilot bindings are provisioned by the trusted app host; unknown senders remain unbound. */
25+ readonly provisionedBindings?: readonly Omit<ProvisionChannelBindingInput, 'channel' | 'agentTypeId'>[]

28+}

34+}
35+
36+export function assertCoreWhatsAppAgentAvailable(
37+ options: CoreWhatsAppChannelOptions | undefined,
38+ agentTypeIds: readonly string[],
39+): void {
40+ if (options && !agentTypeIds.includes(options.agentTypeId)) {
41+ throw new Error(`WhatsApp channel Agent is not in the validated fleet: ${options.agentTypeId}`)
42+ }
43+}

45+/**
46+ * Mounts the Meta edge into the app-owned Fastify host. The caller owns storage,
47+ * workspace authorization, credentials, and lifecycle; the provider owns only
48+ * wire parsing and Graph delivery.
49+ */
50+export async function mountCoreWhatsAppChannel(input: {
51+ readonly app: FastifyInstance
52+ readonly gateway: AgentGateway
53+ readonly storage: AgentHostChannelStorage
54+ readonly resolveAuthorizedScope: (binding: {
55+ readonly workspaceId: string
56+ readonly authSubjectId: string
57+ readonly agentTypeId: string
58+ }) => Promise<AuthorizedAgentScope>
59+ readonly options: CoreWhatsAppChannelOptions
60+}): Promise<MountedCoreWhatsAppChannel> {
61+ const configured = input.options.provisionedBindings ?? []
62+ const configuredKeys = new Set<string>()
63+ for (const binding of configured) {
64+ if (configuredKeys.has(binding.conversationKey)) {
65+ throw new Error(`Duplicate WhatsApp provisioned binding: ${binding.conversationKey}`)
66+ }
67+ configuredKeys.add(binding.conversationKey)
68+ }
69+ // Reconcile the authoritative provisioned set before services resume durable
70+ // queues. Removed senders and bindings under an old configured Agent fail closed.
71+ for (const current of input.storage.bindings.activeBindings()) {
72+ if (current.channel !== WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_ID) continue
73+ if (current.agentTypeId === input.options.agentTypeId && configuredKeys.has(current.conversationKey)) continue
74+ input.storage.bindings.provision({
75+ channel: current.channel,
76+ conversationKey: current.conversationKey,
77+ agentTypeId: current.agentTypeId,
78+ workspaceId: current.workspaceId,
79+ authSubjectId: current.authSubjectId,
80+ status: 'revoked',
81+ sessionKey: current.sessionKey,
82+ outboundCursor: current.outboundCursor,
83+ })
84+ }
85+ for (const binding of configured) {
86+ const current = input.storage.bindings.getBinding(
87+ WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_ID,
88+ binding.conversationKey,
89+ input.options.agentTypeId,
90+ )
91+ // Startup config is declarative. Re-applying an unchanged binding must not
92+ // create a new generation, because acknowledged queue rows retain the old one.
93+ if (current
94+ && current.workspaceId === binding.workspaceId
95+ && current.authSubjectId === binding.authSubjectId
96+ && (binding.sessionKey === undefined || current.sessionKey === binding.sessionKey)
97+ && current.status === (binding.status ?? 'active')) continue
98+ input.storage.bindings.provision({
99+ ...binding,
100+ channel: WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_ID,
101+ agentTypeId: input.options.agentTypeId,
102+ })
103+ }
104+
105+ const adapterEdge = createWhatsAppCloudEdge({
106+ withCredentials: input.options.withCredentials,
107+ agentTypeId: input.options.agentTypeId,
108+ // Assigned after runtime construction; webhook traffic cannot arrive before Fastify is ready.
109+ inbound: { accept: (message, agentTypeId) => runtime.acceptInbound(message, agentTypeId) },
110+ ...(input.options.bodyLimit === undefined ? {} : { bodyLimit: input.options.bodyLimit }),
111+ })
112+ const runtime = createAgentHostChannelRuntime<WhatsAppCloudMessage>({
113+ gateway: input.gateway,
114+ storage: input.storage,
115+ resolveAuthorizedScope: input.resolveAuthorizedScope,
116+ outboundAdapters: new Map([[WHATSAPP_CHANNEL_ID, adapterEdge.adapter]]),
117+ })
118+ const webhookPath = input.options.webhookPath ?? CORE_WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_PATH
119+ const bodyLimit = input.options.bodyLimit ?? WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_BODY_LIMIT
120+ try {
121+ await input.app.register(async (routes) => {
122+ routes.addContentTypeParser('application/json', { parseAs: 'buffer', bodyLimit }, (_request, body, done) => {
123+ done(null, body)
124+ })
125+ routes.route({
126+ method: ['GET', 'POST'],
127+ url: webhookPath,
128+ handler: async (request, reply) => {
129+ const method = request.method === 'GET' ? 'GET' : 'POST'
130+ const headers = new Headers()
131+ for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(request.headers)) {
132+ if (value !== undefined) headers.set(name, Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(',') : value)
133+ }
134+ const body = method === 'POST'
135+ ? request.body instanceof Uint8Array
136+ ? Uint8Array.from(request.body).buffer
137+ : new ArrayBuffer(0)
138+ : undefined
139+ const response = await adapterEdge.webhook(new Request(
140+ new URL(request.raw.url ?? webhookPath, 'http://channel.invalid'),
141+ { method, headers, ...(body === undefined ? {} : { body }) },
142+ ))
143+ reply.code(response.status).type(response.headers.get('content-type') ?? 'text/plain')
144+ return await response.text()
145+ },
146+ })
147+ })
148+ } catch (error) {
149+ await runtime.close()
150+ throw error
151+ }
152+
153+ let closed = false
154+ return {
155+ runtime,
156+ webhookPath,
157+ async close() {
158+ if (closed) return
159+ closed = true
160+ await runtime.close()
161+ },
162+ }
163+}

1+import type { CoreWhatsAppChannelOptions } from '@hachej/boring-core/app/server'
2+
3+const REQUIRED_CREDENTIALS = [
4+ 'BORING_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN',
5+ 'BORING_WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET',
6+ 'BORING_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN',
7+ 'BORING_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID',
8+ 'BORING_WHATSAPP_FALLBACK_TEMPLATE',
9+] as const
10+
11+interface FullAppWhatsAppBinding {
12+ readonly conversationKey: string
13+ readonly workspaceId: string
14+ readonly authSubjectId: string
15+ readonly sessionKey?: string
16+}
17+
18+/** Reads host-owned deployment config without exporting credential material. */
19+export function readFullAppWhatsAppChannelOptions(
20+ defaultAgentTypeId: string,
21+ env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
22+): CoreWhatsAppChannelOptions | undefined {
23+ if (env.BORING_AGENT_CHANNELS !== '1' && env.BORING_AGENT_CHANNELS !== 'true') return undefined
24+
25+ const missing = REQUIRED_CREDENTIALS.filter((name) => !env[name]?.trim())
26+ if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error(`WhatsApp channel credentials missing: ${missing.join(', ')}`)
27+ const bindings = parseBindings(env.BORING_WHATSAPP_BINDINGS_JSON)
28+
29+ return {
30+ agentTypeId: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_AGENT_TYPE_ID?.trim() || defaultAgentTypeId,
31+ provisionedBindings: bindings,
32+ withCredentials: async (use) => await use({
33+ accessToken: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN!.trim(),
34+ appSecret: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET!.trim(),
35+ verifyToken: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN!.trim(),
36+ phoneNumberId: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID!.trim(),
37+ fallbackTemplateName: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_FALLBACK_TEMPLATE!.trim(),
38+ ...(env.BORING_WHATSAPP_FALLBACK_LANGUAGE?.trim()
39+ ? { fallbackTemplateLanguage: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_FALLBACK_LANGUAGE.trim() }
40+ : {}),
41+ ...(env.BORING_WHATSAPP_API_VERSION?.trim() ? { apiVersion: env.BORING_WHATSAPP_API_VERSION.trim() } : {}),
42+ }),
43+ }
44+}
45+
46+function parseBindings(raw: string | undefined): readonly FullAppWhatsAppBinding[] {
47+ if (!raw?.trim()) throw new Error('WhatsApp channel bindings missing: BORING_WHATSAPP_BINDINGS_JSON')
48+ let parsed: unknown
49+ try {
50+ parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
51+ } catch {
52+ throw new Error('WhatsApp channel bindings are invalid JSON')
53+ }
54+ if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || parsed.length === 0 || !parsed.every(isBinding)) {
55+ throw new Error('WhatsApp channel bindings must be a non-empty array of provisioned binding objects')
56+ }
57+ const keys = new Set<string>()
58+ for (const binding of parsed) {
59+ if (keys.has(binding.conversationKey)) throw new Error('WhatsApp channel bindings contain a duplicate conversationKey')
60+ keys.add(binding.conversationKey)
61+ }
62+ return parsed
63+}
64+
65+function isBinding(value: unknown): value is FullAppWhatsAppBinding {
66+ if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return false
67+ const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>
68+ const allowed = new Set(['conversationKey', 'workspaceId', 'authSubjectId', 'sessionKey'])
69+ return Object.keys(candidate).every((key) => allowed.has(key))
70+ && nonEmpty(candidate.conversationKey)
71+ && nonEmpty(candidate.workspaceId)
72+ && nonEmpty(candidate.authSubjectId)
73+ && (candidate.sessionKey === undefined || nonEmpty(candidate.sessionKey))
74+}
75+
76+function nonEmpty(value: unknown): value is string {
77+ return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0
78+}

1+import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises'

23+const bindingInput = {
24+ channel: 'whatsapp',
25+ conversationKey: '+41790000000',
26+ agentTypeId: 'default',
27+ workspaceId: 'workspace-1',
28+ authSubjectId: 'user-1',
29+ sessionKey: 'session-1',
30+} as const
31+
32+async function withChannel(run: (input: {
33+ bindings: ChannelBindingStore
34+ events: SqliteEventStreamStore
35+ path: string
36+ append: (chunk: PiChatEvent, timestamp?: number) => Promise<string>
37+}) => Promise<void>) {
38+ const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'boring-channel-outbound-'))
39+ const db = openDatabase(join(dir, 'channel.sqlite'))
40+ const bindings = new ChannelBindingStore(db.sql, db.runTransaction)
41+ const events = new SqliteEventStreamStore(db.sql, db.runTransaction)
42+ const stream = await events.createSessionStream(
43+ { workspaceScopeId: bindingInput.workspaceId, sessionId: bindingInput.sessionKey },
44+ { agentTypeId: bindingInput.agentTypeId, authSubjectId: bindingInput.authSubjectId },
45+ )
46+ let key = 0
47+ try {
48+ await run({
49+ bindings,
50+ events,
51+ path: stream.path,
52+ append: (chunk, timestamp) => events.appendEvent(stream.path, {
53+ v: 1,
54+ eventIndex: key++,
55+ timestamp: timestamp ?? Date.now(),
56+ sessionId: bindingInput.sessionKey,
57+ chunk,
58+ }),
59+ })
60+ } finally {
61+ db.db.close()
62+ await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
63+ }
64+}
65+
66+function fakeAdapter(sent: string[], templates: string[] = [], serviceWindowMs?: number): ChannelOutboundAdapter<string> {
67+ return {
68+ ...(serviceWindowMs === undefined ? {} : { serviceWindowMs }),
69+ renderOutbound: (turn) => [turn.text],
70+ send: async ({ message }) => { sent.push(message) },
71+ sendWindowTemplate: async ({ conversationKey }) => { templates.push(conversationKey) },
72+ }
73+}
74+
75+function runtime(path: string) {
76+ return {
77+ resolveStreamPath: vi.fn(async () => path),
78+ createSession: vi.fn(async () => 'replacement-session'),
79+ }
80+}
81+
82+async function appendTurn(
83+ append: (chunk: PiChatEvent, timestamp?: number) => Promise<string>,
84+ turnId: string,
85+ text: string,
86+ status: 'ok' | 'aborted' | 'error' = 'ok',
87+ timestamp?: number,
88+) {
89+ await append({ type: 'agent-start', seq: 1, turnId }, timestamp)
90+ await append({
91+ type: 'message-end',
92+ seq: 2,
93+ messageId: `${turnId}-assistant`,
94+ final: {
95+ id: `${turnId}-assistant`,
96+ role: 'assistant',
97+ turnId,
98+ parts: [
99+ { type: 'reasoning', id: 'hidden', text: 'secret', state: 'done' },
100+ { type: 'text', text },
101+ { type: 'tool-call', id: 'tool', toolName: 'read', state: 'output-available' },
102+ ],
103+ },
104+ }, timestamp)
105+ return append({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 3, turnId, status }, timestamp)
106+}

108+describe('durable channel outbound', () => {
109+ test('assembles completed assistant text only and ignores retry terminals', () => {

111+ envelope({ type: 'agent-start', seq: 1, turnId: 'turn-1' }, '0'),
112+ envelope({ type: 'tool-call', seq: 2, messageId: 'a', toolCallId: 'x', toolName: 'read', input: {} }, '1'),
113+ envelope({
114+ type: 'message-end', seq: 3, messageId: 'a',
115+ final: { id: 'a', role: 'assistant', turnId: 'turn-1', parts: [{ type: 'text', text: 'done' }] },
116+ }, '2'),
117+ envelope({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 4, turnId: 'turn-1', status: 'error', willRetry: true }, '3'),
118+ envelope({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 5, turnId: 'turn-1', status: 'ok' }, '4'),
119+ ]
120+ expect(assembleNextTurn(entries)).toEqual({
121+ terminalOffset: '4',
122+ turn: { turnId: 'turn-1', status: 'ok', text: 'done' },
123+ })
124+ })

179+ const sent: string[] = []

183+ const sending = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { started = resolve })

186+ started()
187+ await blocked

195+ await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5))
196+ expect(disposed).toBe(false)
197+ release()
198+ await disposal
199+
200+ const second = new ChannelOutboundService(bindings, events, runtime(path),
201+ new Map([['whatsapp', fakeAdapter(sent)]]))

206+ })

635+async function eventually(predicate: () => boolean, timeoutMs = 1_000): Promise<void> {
636+ const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs
637+ while (!predicate()) {
638+ if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error('Timed out waiting for channel condition.')
639+ await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5))
640+ }

643+function envelope(chunk: PiChatEvent, offset: string) {
644+ return {
645+ offset,
646+ data: { v: 1 as const, eventIndex: Number(offset), timestamp: 1, sessionId: 'session-1', chunk },
647+ }

47+class FakeIntentionRuntime implements ChannelIntentionRuntime {
48+ readonly workspaceId = bindingInput.workspaceId
49+ readonly questions = new Map<string, ChannelIntentionQuestion>()
50+ readonly answers: Array<{ questionId: string; sessionId: string; values: Readonly<Record<string, string>> }> = []
51+ private readonly listeners = new Set<() => void>()
52+
53+ async listPending() {
54+ return [...this.questions.values()].filter((entry) => entry.status === 'ready')
55+ }
56+
57+ async getByQuestionId(questionId: string) {
58+ return this.questions.get(questionId) ?? null
59+ }
60+
61+ async submitAnswer(questionId: string, sessionId: string, values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
62+ const current = this.questions.get(questionId)
63+ if (!current || current.status !== 'ready') throw new Error('already answered')
64+ this.answers.push({ questionId, sessionId, values })
65+ this.questions.set(questionId, { ...current, status: 'answered' })
66+ this.emit()
67+ }
68+
69+ subscribe(listener: () => void) {
70+ this.listeners.add(listener)
71+ return () => this.listeners.delete(listener)
72+ }
73+
74+ publish(value: ChannelIntentionQuestion) {
75+ this.questions.set(value.questionId, value)
76+ this.emit()
77+ }
78+
79+ private emit() {
80+ for (const listener of this.listeners) listener()
81+ }
82+}

84+async function withStore(run: (store: ChannelBindingStore, path: string) => Promise<void>) {
85+ const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'boring-channel-intention-'))
86+ const path = join(dir, 'channels.sqlite')
87+ const db = openDatabase(path)
88+ try {
89+ const store = new ChannelBindingStore(db.sql, db.runTransaction)
90+ store.provision(bindingInput)
91+ await run(store, path)
92+ } finally {
93+ db.db.close()
94+ await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
95+ }
96+}

104+ receivedAt: Date.now(),
105+ }

1+---
2+github: https://github.com/hachej/boring-ui/issues/1127
3+issue: 1127
4+state: external-channels reframe (r4.1) — generic channel registry + descriptor mechanism, WhatsApp as v1 consumer; adversarial-review reframe folded in (2026-08-11): PILOT = provisioned bindings / fail-closed; self-serve signup DEMOTED to Phase 2 but FEASIBLE NOW in two forms (phone-native via better-auth phoneNumber plugin tier-b; email-anchored via accountLinking) per authoritative capability check; better-auth claims corrected against code; descriptor = rendering-only + adapter-owned opaque conversation key; slice 6 verdict = build thin (seed Flue edge + Hermes reference); ready for owner gate merge
5+updated: 2026-09-04
6+supersedes: docs/issues/1127/plan.md (r2.1) — for the channels lane only
7+flag: BORING_AGENT_CHANNELS (from r2.1; channel registry + adapter host are dead code when off)
8+---
9+
10+# gh-1127 — External Channels — execution plan (WhatsApp as v1 consumer) (r4.1)
11+
12+The #1127 channels epic, matured from a WhatsApp-specific lane into a **generic
13+channel registry**. A "channel" is any external surface that drives an agent
14+session; WhatsApp is the **one fully-built consumer** for v1. Everything that is
15+actually WhatsApp-specific is labeled as such; everything generic lives in the
16+registry + descriptor mechanism (§0.5) so the next consumer (Slack, email,

100+
101+## 0.5 The generic mechanism — channel registry + descriptor [GENERIC]
102+
103+This is what the #1127 epic now is. WhatsApp (§0–§8) is the first consumer of
104+this mechanism; the mechanism itself is channel-agnostic.
105+
106+### 0.5.1 A channel is a typed descriptor in a registry
107+
108+A **channel** is any external surface that drives an agent session (WhatsApp,
109+Slack, email, a spreadsheet add-in). The registry holds one **descriptor** per
110+channel:
111+
112+**The descriptor is the WORKSPACE-RENDERING contract — nothing more.** It carries
113+only what the workspace UI needs to render a channel-originated session: icon,
114+read-only badge, dialect/formatting. It deliberately does **not** carry
115+delivery, threading, credentials, webhook, or media semantics — **those are
116+adapter-owned** (§3.2, §0.5.5). The descriptor generalizes the *rendering*; the
117+adapter owns *delivery/threading/credentials*.
118+
119+```ts
120+interface ChannelDescriptor {
121+ id: string // 'whatsapp' | 'web' | 'slack' | 'email' | 'excel' | …
122+ label: string // human label for the badge/filter
123+ icon: string // rendered in the session pane; NO per-channel UI code
124+ sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace: boolean// true → workspace reopen is read-only (§6.5); per-deployment
125+ // POLICY default, not channel nature (see §0.5.4, C1)
126+ dialect: ChannelDialect // OPEN-ENDED formatting/chunking tag (NOT a frozen enum);
127+ // §3-shaping; 'web' = passthrough
128+ // capability FLAG only — documents whether this channel's inbound can create/authenticate
129+ // an identity. It does NOT drive a generic mechanism; identity wiring is consumer-specific
130+ // (§0.5.3, §6.6). It gates ONE thing: whether the adapter's inbound path is ALLOWED to reach
131+ // an identity-minting route at all. web=true (web IS where signup happens), whatsapp=true
132+ // (phase 2 only), slack/email/excel=false.
133+ canOriginateIdentity: boolean
134+}
135+```
136+
137+`ChannelDialect` is an **open string tag**, not an enum frozen at
138+`web|whatsapp` — future descriptors (e.g. `excel/cell`, `slack/mrkdwn`) add tags
139+without a registry change.
140+
141+`'web'` is a descriptor too — the default for everything that exists today
142+(`sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace: false`, `dialect: passthrough`). Its
143+`canOriginateIdentity` is **`true`**: web is where every existing signup happens
144+(email/password, Google, GitHub). Adding a channel is **registering a descriptor
145++ building an adapter**, never editing session-pane UI.
146+
147+### 0.5.2 Sessions carry `originChannel`
148+
149+Every session carries a typed **`originChannel`** property (the descriptor `id`).
150+This **is** the implementation of the already-planned "channel = first-class
151+typed session property" (§6.4): `'whatsapp'` for WhatsApp-originated sessions,
152+`'web'` for everything existing, future channels reuse the field. The workspace
153+reads `originChannel`, looks up the descriptor, and renders from it — badge,
154+filter, read-only gating, dialect selection all flow from `descriptor =
155+registry[session.originChannel]`. No code branches on a hardcoded channel name.
156+
157+### 0.5.3 Two orthogonal capabilities a channel MAY have
158+
159+The core design insight. A channel may have either, both, or (in principle)
160+neither of two **independent** capabilities:
161+
162+| Capability | What it means | Descriptor field |
163+| --- | --- | --- |
164+| **(a) Interaction surface** | Chat with the agent from here — inbound → session, outbound replies. **ALL channels have this** (it is what makes something a channel). | implicit (every descriptor + its adapter) |
165+| **(b) Can originate identity** | The channel's inbound is *permitted* to reach an identity-minting/authenticating route. **Only some channels.** This is a **gate**, not a mechanism: `true` means "inbound MAY create/authenticate"; `false` means the adapter's inbound path is fail-closed against identity routes. The identity *mechanism* itself is consumer-specific wiring (§6.6), never generic. | `canOriginateIdentity` |
166+
167+- **web = true.** Web is where every existing signup happens today
168+ (email/password, Google, GitHub). The flag exists precisely so web is not a
169+ special case.
170+- **WhatsApp = both — but capability (b) is PHASE 2, not pilot.** The pilot uses
171+ **provisioned bindings** (§0.7): a customer's number is known/allowlisted
172+ ahead of time, so pilot inbound never mints identity — `canOriginateIdentity`
173+ is a gate that stays **closed on the pilot path**. Self-serve signup (Phase 2)
174+ opens the gate via **two feasible flows** — phone-native (`phoneNumber` plugin,
175+ tier (b) moderate) or email-anchored (§6.6). Both buildable now.
176+- **Slack / email / pi-excel = interaction only.** `canOriginateIdentity:
177+ false` — a user is already authenticated in the host product.
178+
179+Keeping these orthogonal is what stops "channel" from collapsing into "auth
180+provider": the identity work (§6.6/§7.5) is a **Phase-2** capability of the
181+WhatsApp consumer, not a tax every channel pays and **not on the pilot critical
182+path**.
183+
184+### 0.5.5 The adapter owns delivery, threading, and credentials [GENERIC]
185+
186+The descriptor is rendering-only (§0.5.1); **everything that makes a channel a
187+channel at the wire level is adapter-owned**, behind the `ChannelAdapter`
188+contract (§3.2):
189+
190+- **Threading model.** WhatsApp = session-per-sender; Slack = per-thread
191+ (`team:channel:thread_ts`); email = per-subject-thread; excel = per-workbook.
192+ The store does **not** encode this — see the opaque conversation key below.
193+- **Delivery constraints.** WhatsApp's 24h-window + template fallback (§7.1)
194+ lives entirely in the WhatsApp adapter + slices 1a/1b, **not** the descriptor.
195+- **Webhook / credential / media model, delivery semantics (at-least-once).**
196+ All adapter-owned.
197+
198+**Binding key is an OPAQUE, adapter-owned conversation key — not a fixed
199+`(channel, externalId)` tuple.** The `ChannelBindingStore` maps
200+`(channel, conversationKey[, agentTypeId]) → (workspaceId, sessionKey)` where
201+`conversationKey` is an **opaque string the adapter mints and interprets**.
202+WhatsApp's is the sender number; Slack's is `team:channel:thread`; email's is a
203+normalized thread id. This is what lets consumer #2 (Slack/email) fit **without
204+a store schema change** — the store never parses the key. Documented honestly:
205+the store layer is generic because it treats the key as opaque; the *meaning* of
206+the key is the adapter's.
207+
208+### 0.5.4 Session pane renders purely from the descriptor [GENERIC]
209+
210+The workspace session pane renders **channel icon + read-only-in-workspace
211+badge** by reading `registry[session.originChannel]` — `icon` and
212+`sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace`. There is **no per-channel UI code**: a new channel
213+appears in the pane the moment its descriptor is registered. This is the generic
214+form of the earlier "mark WhatsApp sessions read-only with an icon" ask (§6.5),
215+done once for all channels. Slice 7 delivers this descriptor-driven rendering
216+using WhatsApp as its first descriptor.
217+
218+---
219+
220+## 0.6 Registry-ready future consumers — NOTED ONLY, zero v1 scope [GENERIC]
221+
222+These prove the mechanism is generic. **None carries a work item or slice in this
223+plan; there is zero implementation scope for any of them in v1.** They are listed
224+only to show a new consumer is "register a descriptor + build an adapter":
225+
226+| Future consumer | Capabilities | Descriptor sketch | Status |
227+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
228+| **pi-excel** (spreadsheet add-in) | interaction only | `{ id:'excel', canOriginateIdentity:false, sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace:true, dialect:'excel/cell' }` (opaque conversationKey = per-workbook) | **Noted only.** A prior demo branch **`demo/pi-excel-coupling`** already validates the channel-coupling pattern end-to-end. Owner ruling: *ignore pi-excel implementation, just note as future consumer.* |
229+| **Slack** | interaction only | `{ id:'slack', canOriginateIdentity:false, sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace:true, dialect:'slack/mrkdwn' }` (opaque conversationKey = `team:channel:thread`) | Noted only. `@flue/slack` ingress exists (§2.3) if/when built. Slack threading needs **no store schema change** — the key is opaque (§0.5.5). A future Slack deployment with two-way reply would set `sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace:false` — it is a policy default, not channel nature (C1). |
230+| **email** | interaction only | `{ id:'email', canOriginateIdentity:false, sessionsReadOnlyInWorkspace:true, dialect:'email/html' }` (opaque conversationKey = normalized subject-thread) | Noted only. Distinct from the #1165 email *identity* path (which is an identity provider on the web side, not a channel). |
231+
232+Each is a descriptor + an adapter behind the same `ChannelAdapter` contract
233+(§3.2) the WhatsApp consumer defines; none needs new session-pane UI, new
234+identity machinery, or a new mechanism. **Do not scope them here.**
235+
236+---
237+
238+## 0.7 Pilot trust posture — PROVISIONED BINDINGS (fail-closed) [WA-SPECIFIC]
239+
240+**The pilot inbound model is provisioned bindings, not open signup.** This is the
241+single load-bearing trust decision, resolving the 1a-vs-1c contradiction the
242+adversarial review flagged (R1). It reinstates the ratified r2.1 §7.3 posture and
243+removes the "unknown sender = signup" ruling from the **pilot** path.
244+
245+- **Known/allowlisted senders only.** A customer's phone number is
246+ **provisioned by us during onboarding** (CLI/admin op, r2.1) and bound ahead of
247+ time to their pre-created workspace/session. The binding table is the entire
248+ trust decision.
249+- **Unknown sender = fail-closed.** An inbound from a number with no binding gets
250+ **no session, no account, no signup** — a rate-limited polite rejection with a
251+ stable code (§7.2). There is exactly one inbound trust rule in the pilot, and
252+ it is deny-by-default.
253+- **Why this shape.** The pilot needs zero identity build: no phone-keyed
254+ better-auth work, no account-minting abuse surface, no merge flow. It ships
255+ fast and safe. Onboarding is a provisioning step we run, not a self-serve
256+ funnel.
257+
258+**Self-serve product signup is Phase 2 — and it is FEASIBLE NOW in two forms.**
259+Self-serve signup is moved **off the pilot critical path**, but it is not a hard
260+build. The recovered better-auth composition report
261+(`references/betterauth-spike-report.md`, with its reproducibility limitation
262+stated explicitly) establishes **two feasible flows** (§6.6):
263+**Flow 1 — phone-native** (WhatsApp-first) signup via better-auth's `phoneNumber`
264+plugin (`signUpOnVerification` + `sendOTP` over WhatsApp + `getTempEmail`
265+placeholder, replaced by the real email at first payment) — **tier (b),
266+moderate**; and **Flow 2 — email-anchored** (LP signup / signed-round-trip-token)
267+with WhatsApp linked via `accountLinking`. Both carry the abuse controls (§7.2
268+Phase-2 subsection). **Pilot = provisioned bindings (simplest, one customer);
269+product signup = phone-native OR email-anchored, both feasible now (Phase 2).**
270+
271+| | **Pilot (v1)** | **Phase 2 — Flow 1 (phone-native)** | **Phase 2 — Flow 2 (email-anchored)** |
272+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
273+| Inbound from unknown number | fail-closed, no session | phone-OTP signup from thread (`phoneNumber` plugin) | signed-token → web email signup, link WhatsApp |
274+| Identity anchor | pre-provisioned account | **phone** + `getTempEmail` placeholder | **email** (native today) |
275+| Enabling work | bindings only | add `phoneNumber` plugin + `sendOTP`→WhatsApp (tier b, moderate) | turn on `accountLinking` (§6.6) |
276+| Real email | already present on the provisioned account | at first payment (`changeEmail`, not `updateUser`) | day one |
277+| Abuse controls | rate-limited rejection | account-minting caps (§7.2 Phase 2) | account-minting caps (§7.2 Phase 2) |
278+| `canOriginateIdentity` (WhatsApp) | **closed** | opened (mints phone account) | opened (mints email account) |
279+
280+---
281+
282+## Step 0 — Meta App Review submission (FIRST ACTION OF THE WHATSAPP CONSUMER) [WA-SPECIFIC]
283+
284+This is step 0 because Slice 6 (the provider edge) cannot be demoed without it
285+and the owner cites ~24h turnaround. It is owner-side, not engineering-side, and
286+it runs in parallel with slices 1–5.
287+
288+**Scope of the Meta setup (2026-08-11 identity ruling, §6.6):** this is
289+**one verified Seneca WABA + Meta business verification** for our own number —
290+the number users text. That is all this model needs. **Embedded Signup and
291+per-customer OAuth are explicitly OUT of scope**: they exist only to send *as a
292+customer's own number*, whereas here users text OUR number and their number is
293+merely their identity. The weeks-long per-customer-verification gate does not
294+exist on this path. Per-customer Embedded Signup remains a **separate future
295+capability**, in scope only if a specific customer later wants replies sent on
296+their own number.
297+
298+### 0.1 Prerequisites to have in hand before opening the form
299+
300+- **Meta Business Account**, with Business Verification started (legal entity
301+ name, registered address, and a verifiable phone/website that match public
302+ records). This is the long pole if it has not been done — App Review is ~24h,
303+ *business verification is not*.
304+- **Meta App** of type "Business", with the **WhatsApp** product added.
305+- **A phone number** for the Seneca number that is not already registered to a
306+ WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business consumer account. If it is, deregister first —
307+ this is the single most common multi-day blocker.
308+- **Display name** for the WhatsApp Business Profile that complies with Meta's
309+ display-name policy (must relate to the business; no generic words).
310+- **Privacy policy URL** — publicly reachable, describing message-content
311+ handling, retention, and the transcription sub-processor (§6.3). Meta rejects
312+ placeholder/404 privacy URLs.
313+- **Verified webhook endpoint**: public HTTPS with a valid certificate,
314+ answering the `hub.challenge` handshake. Meta validates this during setup, so
315+ slice 6's webhook must be reachable (a stub that only answers the handshake is
316+ sufficient at this stage and can ship before the rest).
317+
318+### 0.2 Permissions to request
319+
320+| Permission | Why | Notes |
321+| --- | --- | --- |
322+| `whatsapp_business_messaging` | send + receive messages | the core grant |
323+| `whatsapp_business_management` | manage phone numbers, message templates | needed for the 24h-window template (§7.1) |
324+
325+Do **not** request `business_management` unless a reviewer asks — extra
326+permissions lengthen review.
327+
328+### 0.3 What to submit for each permission
329+
330+Meta reviews a **screencast plus a written use-case**. Submit:
331+
332+1. **Written use case** (per permission), stating plainly: a Seneca-operated
333+ business number; end users initiate contact; the agent answers questions and
334+ returns quotes; no marketing, no bulk/unsolicited messaging, no list-buying.
335+2. **Screencast** showing the end-to-end flow from a real device: user sends a
336+ message → agent replies → user receives an artifact link. Record it against
337+ the test number in Development mode (available before approval).
338+3. **Test credentials / instructions** so a reviewer can reproduce: the test
339+ number, a sample opening message, and expected reply.
340+4. **Opt-in evidence**: describe how users consent to be messaged. Since v1 is
341+ strictly user-initiated within the 24h window, state that explicitly — it is
342+ the easiest review posture to defend.
343+
344+### 0.4 Message template to submit at the same time
345+
346+Submit the single 24h-window fallback template from r2.1 §3 for approval in the
347+same pass (template approval is separate from App Review and also ~24h):
348+
349+- Category: **UTILITY** (not MARKETING — marketing templates draw scrutiny and
350+ cost more).
351+- Body: a re-engagement notice with no promotional content, e.g. "Your Seneca
352+ assistant has an update on your request. Reply to continue."
353+
354+### Step 0 exit criteria
355+
356+- App Review approved for both permissions.
357+- Business verification cleared.
358+- One phone number registered, display name approved.
359+- One UTILITY template approved.
360+- Webhook handshake verified by Meta against our public endpoint.
361+
362+**Gate:** slices 1–5 do not block on this. Only slice 6's live **production**
363+demo does — and even that has a dev-loop escape hatch: hermes-agent's Baileys
364+bridge (§2.5) can demo the channel end-to-end before verification completes,
365+under the never-for-customer-numbers caveat.

369+## 1. Prior art and what we revive
370+
371+### 1.1 `docs/issues/1127/plan.md` (r2.1) — the ratified shape, revived
372+
373+Merged to main in `68e4a6cba` (PR #1140), adversarially reviewed twice. It is
374+correct and this plan does not re-litigate it. Revived verbatim:
375+
376+- **§1 pipeline**: webhook → signature verify → parse → **durable enqueue keyed
377+ by `(channel, providerMessageId)` in one sqlite transaction** → immediate 200
378+ ack → per-binding serialized drain worker → `prompt`/`followUp`.
379+- **§1 outbound**: per-binding worker tails `eventStore.readEvents(streamPath,
380+ { offset: binding.cursor })`, assembles turns against the terminal-event
381+ contract, renders, sends, then advances the cursor by compare-and-set.
382+- **The honesty about semantics**: outbound is **at-least-once**. "send precedes
383+ the CAS… CAS prevents cursor divergence, **not** duplicate sends (WhatsApp
384+ offers no send idempotency key)."
385+- **§2 binding store schema and gone-session policy**, including "the cursor
386+ resets whenever **any** sessionKey component changes".
387+- **§2 trust model**: the adapter is a host-side trusted caller minting
388+ `AuthorizedAgentScope` from a binding row, with the stated guardrails. Still
389+ the one genuinely new seam.
390+- **§3 shaping**: WhatsApp dialect (`*bold*`, `_italic_`), 4096-char chunking on
391+ paragraph boundaries, fence close/reopen on hard splits, completed turns only.
392+- **§4 auth**: `X-Hub-Signature-256` HMAC + handshake before any parsing;
393+ credentials via `server/credentials/`; `channelId` opaque in core contracts.
394+- **Decisions 1, 2, 4, 5** (durable store not the HTTP route; fake-channel
395+ conformance harness; durable inbound dedupe; same process as
396+ `HarnessPiChatService`).
397+
398+### 1.2 The #391 lineage — three things r2.1 missed
399+
400+`docs/issues/391/runtime-refactor/` contains an older, in places **more
401+rigorous** channel design. Three findings must be folded in:
402+
403+**(a) `Agent.followUp` may strand — r2.1 assumes it works.**
404+r2.1 §1 says "if the session is busy it uses `followUp`". CHAN-A
405+(`.../work/S1-slack-channel/CHAN-A-chat-sdk-transport.md`, v6 FINAL) analysed
406+this path and found it broken: "a turn drains queued follow-ups only at pi's
407+per-run final poll or an idle `continue()` … → poll-then-clear stranding". Its
408+BCH-001 adds `Agent.followUp(input)` plus a service-level **`DrainCoordinator`**
409+in `HarnessPiChatService` with `phase ∈ {idle, running, draining, interrupting}`
410+under a per-session mutex. **A channel is exactly the workload that hits this**
411+(a user sends three WhatsApp messages in a row mid-turn). Folded into slice 1a
412+as a hard prerequisite, with a failing test first.
413+
414+**(b) The create-race is under-specified in r2.1.**
415+r2.1 says sessions are "created lazily on first inbound". CHAN-A's BCH-003
416+specifies an **owner-token CAS state machine** — `creating → admitting → ready`,
417+`casState(key, expectedOwner, next, ttlMs)` as `UPDATE … WHERE key=? AND
418+owner=?` (rowcount===1), `RESERVATION_TTL=30_000ms`, loser backoff 50→500ms,
419+`MAX_RESERVATION_CYCLES=2` then a stable `SESSION_CREATE_TIMEOUT`. Its recovery
420+cases are the ones that matter: an **expired `admitting`** record means the
421+winner crashed *after* allocating, so the session exists and must **not** be
422+re-allocated or re-admitted. Lifted verbatim into `ChannelBindingStore`.
423+
424+**(c) The two-handles rule.**
425+`.../architecture/08-pluggable-agent-surfaces.md`: "`sessionId` — runtime-owned
426+… Continuation/addressing — surface-owned … Public agent APIs never accept
427+platform addressing" and "A surface must never synthesize a fake `workspaceId`."
428+Our binding table *is* the surface-owned addressing map. Enforced by a guard
429+test (no phone number reaches an agent API).
430+
431+### 1.3 What is NOT prior art
432+
433+- **No code was ever written.** `git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-only --
434+ "packages/channels/*"` is empty. Branches `bclaw/boring-channels` and
435+ `bclaw/slack-flue-channels` are stale pointers with empty diffs against main.
436+ The only artifact that ever existed is a gitignored `.d.ts` prototype.
437+- **CHAN-A and CH1 are non-dispatchable** — they carry "historical snapshot;
438+ non-dispatchable" banners. We mine them for design, not for sequencing.
439+- **CH1 ordered Telegram first, WhatsApp second, gated on a cost spike.**
440+ Superseded by the owner ruling.
